# Resource: stripe_product_feature

An entitlement feature attached to a product. `terraform destroy` detaches the feature from the product and leaves the `stripe_entitlements_feature` in place. Import with `<product_id>/<product_feature_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_product" "gold" {
  name = "Gold plan"
}

resource "stripe_entitlements_feature" "advanced_search" {
  lookup_key = "advanced_search"
  name       = "Advanced search"
}

resource "stripe_product_feature" "gold_search" {
  product             = stripe_product.gold.id
  entitlement_feature = stripe_entitlements_feature.advanced_search.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `entitlement_feature` - (Required) The ID of the [Feature](https://docs.stripe.com/api/entitlements/feature) object attached to this product. Changing it replaces the resource.
* `product` - (Required) The ID of the parent object. Changing it replaces the resource.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

The ID is the product ID and the product feature ID, separated by a slash.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a product feature using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_product_feature.gold_search
  id = "prod_123/prodft_456"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_product_feature.gold_search
  identity = {
    product = "prod_123"
    id      = "prodft_456"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `product` (String) The ID of the parent product.
* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the product feature.

Using `terraform import`, import a product feature using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_product_feature.gold_search prod_123/prodft_456
```
